page.notes: The Greek phrase after "Aristoteli est ens" is not legible enough to read letter by letter, so it is marked as illegible. The title lines are set in capitals and the first "INDEX" is set apart by an ornament band; both are given as heads. The marginal note at the top right is in bold italic and is placed beside the "A." line. Entries are italic and set as printed; no running head or page number is printed on this part. The left column is cut off; only its last two lines are visible at the bottom left, and the top of that fragment is faded and illegible. The final word of the last line is partly obscured.
